{{Quote|The creatures we were using are a strain related to vonduun crabs. We employed another device while doing forensic examinations of the searchers that had failed. The searchers had inflammations of their respiratory systems, and with the new scanning creatures, we discovered pollen grains. The searchers died of an allergic reaction to the pollen. Vonduun crab armor had a more immediate and violent reaction to the pollen.|[[Deign Lian]]|<ref name="DTII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
The '''vonduun crab''' was a [[Crab/Legends|crab]]-like organism in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were used to [[Shaping protocol|shape]] the [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|armor]] suits of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==History==
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] discovered that the [[bafforr tree]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] could be used against the [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|vonduun crab armor]] worn by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], as the crab was allergic to the pollen produced by the tree. This reaction would cause the vonduun crab to swell, killing the crab and anyone wearing it.<ref name="DTII" />

Vonduun crab armor was protected by the same energy field that an [[amphistaff]] carried, generated by a [[power gland]]. For this reason, it could withstand the atomic-diameter edge of an amphistaff, and even a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The vonduun crab living shell first appeared as part of the Vonduun Skerr Kyrric armor of the Yuuzhan Vong in the [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', written by [[R. A. Salvatore]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> The creature made its first appearance in the [[2000]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'' written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]].<ref name="DTII" />
